question: How do the foremost mantra-knowers identify the Atidurgā mantra?
premises: They refer to the Atidurgā mantra
They designate it as the day-weapon
inference: The foremost mantra-knowers declare the Atidurgā mantra to be the day-weapon.
plain_english: The foremost knowers of mantras declare the Atidurgā mantra to be the day-weapon.
